plugins.name: Jupyter notebook
plugins.description: Write and import notebooks in your browser. Connect your own Python API to run cells, and share saved results with readers.
features: Browser notebook editor with code, Markdown and raw cells
Optional execution through your external Python API
Saved outputs for readers, with no local kernel
plugins.releaseNotes: Portable browser package replaces the experimental bundled Python runtime. Configure your independently hosted notebook service in API connection settings. Existing article source is preserved.

plugins.name: Three.js scenes
plugins.description: Build and explore interactive 3D scenes directly in the browser. No Node.js service or server runtime is needed.
features: Three.js code execution in a browser worker
Interactive orbit, zoom and animation controls
plugins.releaseNotes: Portable browser-only package. Three.js execution uses a disposable browser worker; no Node.js runtime or server process is installed. Existing scene source and saved outputs remain compatible.

plugins.name: API playground
plugins.description: Let readers try your API from an article. Margin forwards approved requests and keeps configured credentials on the server.
features: Editable JSON requests and response viewer
Fixed API action through Margin’s Go HTTP bridge
Reader interactions require explicit owner permission
plugins.releaseNotes: Initial portable API playground. Configure your public HTTPS base URL; the component POSTs JSON to /try. Reader access is off until explicitly enabled by the owner.
